title: Stray Kids: From 5-Star to KARMA
description: Ten questions on Stray Kids since 2023: 5-Star, Rock-Star, ATE, Hop, KARMA, the Japanese releases and the Dominate stadium tour.

questions.question: Before its June 2023 release, 5-Star set a K-pop preorder record. Roughly how many preorders did it gather?
questions.fun_fact: The 12-track album was the group's first release in eight months, according to Yonhap.

questions.question: Which song, the lead single of Rock-Star, became Stray Kids' first entry on the Billboard Hot 100?
questions.fun_fact: Its Korean title, Rak, means pleasure, and it entered the Hot 100 at number 90.

questions.question: Which two actors appear in the Chk Chk Boom music video, dressed as Deadpool and Wolverine?
questions.fun_fact: I.N had said he wanted to try Latin music in the group's own colors, and the song mixes hip-hop with reggaeton.

questions.question: Which world tour did Stray Kids launch in August 2024 in support of ATE?
questions.fun_fact: JYP Entertainment said the title reflects the group's ambition to dominate the stage as global top artists.

questions.question: On the Dominate tour, Stray Kids became the first act ever to perform at which Toronto venue?
questions.fun_fact: The tour's concert film, The Dominate Experience, was shot at SoFi Stadium and premiered in February 2026.

questions.question: Hop, released in December 2024, was marketed as the first record in which Stray Kids series?
questions.fun_fact: Its lead single was Walkin on Water, while Canadian rapper Tablo is featured on a different track, U.

questions.question: Which song was the lead single of KARMA, the studio album Stray Kids released in August 2025?
questions.fun_fact: Its futuristic sports-themed music video features a cameo from professional gamer Faker.

questions.question: When KARMA debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in 2025, which No. 1 was it for Stray Kids?
questions.fun_fact: It also put Stray Kids ahead of BTS for the most Billboard 200 No. 1s by a K-pop act.

questions.question: Which Japanese singer-songwriter is featured on Social Path, from Stray Kids' 2023 Japanese EP?
questions.fun_fact: The EP topped the Oricon Albums Chart and was certified million by the Recording Industry Association of Japan.

questions.question: Night and Falling Up, singles from the 2024 Japanese album Giant, are themes for which anime?
questions.fun_fact: The album reached No. 1 on the Oricon Albums Chart and on Billboard Japan Hot Albums, and went double platinum in Japan.

title: SEVENTEEN: The Face the Sun Era
description: Relive SEVENTEEN's 2022 run: Face the Sun, Hot, Darl+ing, the Inner Shadows trailers, Sector 17 with _World and the Be the Sun tour.

questions.question: Which song was the lead single of SEVENTEEN's 2022 album Face the Sun?
questions.fun_fact: Woozi co-wrote it with writers including Bumzu and August Rigo, and the track is built around Western-style guitar riffs.

questions.question: Face the Sun is which full-length studio album in SEVENTEEN's discography?
questions.fun_fact: It was the group's first studio album since An Ode in 2019, and Pledis released it through YG Plus.

questions.question: Which song, released ahead of Face the Sun in April 2022, was SEVENTEEN's first English-lyric single?
questions.fun_fact: Dedicated to the group's international fans, it topped the iTunes music charts in 34 countries after its April release.

questions.question: Roughly how many pre-orders did Face the Sun collect before its release?
questions.fun_fact: It beat the group's previous pre-order best of 1.41 million, set by their EP Attacca.

questions.question: At what position did Face the Sun debut on the US Billboard 200, the group's first top 10 there?
questions.fun_fact: It earned 44,000 equivalent album units in its first week, and 42,000 of those came from album sales.

questions.question: Which world tour did SEVENTEEN launch in 2022 to support Face the Sun?
questions.fun_fact: The tour opened with two Seoul concerts on June 25 and 26, 2022, before heading to the US and Canada.

questions.question: What was the title of the July 2022 repackage of Face the Sun?
questions.fun_fact: The repackage had already passed 1.2 million pre-orders a few days before its July 18, 2022 release.

questions.question: Which song was the lead track of the repackage Sector 17?
questions.fun_fact: Pledis explained that the underscore stands for all the open ways SEVENTEEN and their fans can interpret the world.

questions.question: Which 13-part YouTube trailer series did SEVENTEEN start on April 26, 2022 to tease Face the Sun?
questions.fun_fact: According to Hoshi, the album marked the group leaving its old image behind and growing up.

questions.question: Hot won first place on M Countdown in June 2022. On which KBS music show did it also win?
questions.fun_fact: The song was also nominated for Best K-Pop at the MTV Video Music Awards.

title: K-pop Hits and Their Albums
description: Match ten famous K-pop singles to the albums they belong to, with one hit each from ten groups, from BIGBANG and Apink to IVE.

questions.question: Baddie, released in October 2023, was a single from which IVE release?
questions.fun_fact: It spent three weeks at No. 1 on the Circle Digital Chart, giving IVE a fifth chart-topper there.

questions.question: Pink Venom was the lead single of which BLACKPINK album?
questions.fun_fact: It held No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200 for two weeks; no girl group had led that chart before.

questions.question: Talk That Talk, released in August 2022, was the lead single of which TWICE EP?
questions.fun_fact: Collapsedone, who had co-composed earlier TWICE singles like Knock Knock and The Feels, wrote the music with Like; Danke penned the lyrics.

questions.question: Mr. Chu, from 2014, was the lead single of which Apink mini album?
questions.fun_fact: Composed by Duble Sidekick, the song earned Apink six music show trophies.

questions.question: Supernova was the lead single of which aespa album?
questions.fun_fact: It was aespa's first song to top the Circle Digital Chart, where it spent eleven non-consecutive weeks at No. 1.

questions.question: Ko Ko Bop, from 2017, was the lead single of which EXO studio album?
questions.fun_fact: SM Entertainment released the song in two versions, one in Korean and one in Chinese.

questions.question: Red Flavor was the lead single of which Red Velvet EP?
questions.fun_fact: Written by Kenzie, the summery dance-pop song arrived in July 2017 with a fruit-filled music video.

questions.question: Wannabe was the lead single of which ITZY release?
questions.fun_fact: Galactika, the team that made ITZY's debut hit Dalla Dalla, handled both the writing and the production.

questions.question: Fantastic Baby came out alongside which 2012 BIGBANG EP?
questions.fun_fact: BIGBANG's G-Dragon and T.O.P co-wrote it with Teddy Park, and G-Dragon and Teddy also composed and produced it.

questions.question: Kick It, from 2020, was the lead single of which NCT 127 studio album?
questions.fun_fact: Its Korean title means hero, and its music video has a martial arts theme.

title: K-pop Hitmakers and Their Groups
description: Who is behind the hits? Match ten K-pop producers and songwriting teams, from Pdogg and Teddy Park to Black Eyed Pilseung, with their groups.

questions.question: The production duo Black Eyed Pilseung wrote Like Ooh-Ahh, Cheer Up and TT for which group?
questions.fun_fact: The duo later set up High Up Entertainment and debuted their own girl group, STAYC, in November 2020.

questions.question: Which Big Hit producer helped bring a young RM to the label and went on to become BTS's main producer?
questions.fun_fact: KOMCA named him the highest-earning songwriter and composer of 2018 at its February 2019 awards.

questions.question: London duo LDN Noise is best known in K-pop for tracks for groups from which agency?
questions.fun_fact: Greg Bonnick and Hayden Chapman got their first writing credit with Chris Brown's Turn Up the Music, a UK No. 1 in 2012.

questions.question: Longtime SM songwriter Kenzie wrote which Girls' Generation debut song?
questions.fun_fact: Kenzie graduated from Berklee College of Music in 1999, where she majored in music production and engineering.

questions.question: Longtime SM producer Yoo Young-jin, who left the label in 2023, wrote songs for which first-generation boy band?
questions.fun_fact: His credits run from S.E.S. and BoA to TVXQ, Girls' Generation, SHINee, EXO, Red Velvet, NCT and aespa.

questions.question: Sweetune, a team known for 1980s-style synth-pop, produced the albums Lupin and Step for which group?
questions.fun_fact: Founded by Han Jae-ho and Kim Seung-soo, the team also produced for Infinite, Rainbow and Nine Muses.

questions.question: Duble Sidekick rose to fame in 2012 by producing the EP 100% Ver. for which boy band?
questions.fun_fact: The duo pairs lyricist Park Jang-geun with composer Mikey, a former member of the group One Way.

questions.question: Producer Ryan S. Jhun's first hands-on K-pop track was Lucifer. Which group recorded it?
questions.fun_fact: His first released song was Chitty Chitty Bang Bang, on Lee Hyori's 2010 album H-Logic.

questions.question: Before producing for YG Entertainment, Teddy Park debuted in 1998 as a member of which hip hop group?
questions.fun_fact: He went on to produce the KPop Demon Hunters soundtrack, and its song Golden brought him an Academy Award for Best Original Song.

questions.question: J.Y. Park co-wrote Nobody, which took him onto the Billboard Hot 100 in 2009. Which group sang it?
questions.fun_fact: Park and Rainstone became the first Korean songwriters on the Hot 100 when the song debuted at No. 76 in October 2009.

title: ENHYPEN: Sweet Venom to The Sin Quiz
description: Ten easy questions on ENHYPEN's 2023 to 2026 releases: Orange Blood, Romance: Untold, Desire: Unleash, The Sin series and a first Billboard No. 1.

questions.question: Which song was the title track of ENHYPEN's November 2023 EP Orange Blood?
questions.fun_fact: Hanteo counted more than 1.38 million copies of Orange Blood sold on release day alone.

questions.question: At San Diego Comic-Con 2026, ENHYPEN shared a panel with actors from which vampire film series?
questions.fun_fact: On the panel, the members talked about why vampire stories keep drawing in each new generation.

questions.question: What was the lead single of ENHYPEN's July 2024 studio album Romance: Untold?
questions.fun_fact: The album was teased with a short film made in collaboration with director Lee Chung-hyun.

questions.question: Which song led Romance: Untold -Daydream-, the reissue ENHYPEN released in November 2024?
questions.fun_fact: Released on November 11, 2024, the reissue added two new songs to the original album.

questions.question: Bad Desire (With or Without You), released in June 2025, is a single from which ENHYPEN EP?
questions.fun_fact: Its pre-orders topped 2.18 million, giving ENHYPEN a third album in the double-million club.

questions.question: Which US talk show hosted ENHYPEN's first performance on American television, in April 2025?
options: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
The Late Show with Stephen Colbert
questions.fun_fact: They performed Loose, a digital single the group had released earlier that month.

questions.question: ENHYPEN played the Sahara Tent at which US festival in April 2025?
questions.fun_fact: At the end of their second weekend set, they revealed the title and release date of their next EP.

questions.question: Which song led The Sin: Vanish, the January 2026 EP that opened ENHYPEN's The Sin series?
questions.fun_fact: To tease the EP, the group launched a fictional news website called Vampire Now.

questions.question: What was the lead single of The Sin: Bliss, the EP ENHYPEN released in August 2026?
questions.fun_fact: A preview of the Brazilian funk song was first played at the group's concert in Brazil on the Blood Saga Tour.

questions.question: Which release gave ENHYPEN their first No. 1 on the US Billboard 200, in 2026?
questions.fun_fact: It debuted at the top with 98,000 equivalent album units, 92,000 of them from album sales.
